item.title: Ducks send Ryan Strome to Flames for draft pick in deadline deal
item.description: The 32-year-old center, swapped for a 2027 seventh-round pick, had been a favorite in the stands and locker room alike since arriving in 2022, but he had played in just over half the team’s games this season.

item.title: Dean Herrington excited for new job as football coach at St. Bernard
item.description: Herrington has won two CIF Southern Section championships during a lengthy coaching career that includes stints at St. Francis, Alemany and Paraclete.

item.title: A steady insider steps in: Andres Chait leads LAUSD amid federal scrutiny
item.description: The acting superintendent, a longtime LAUSD administrator and former teacher, takes charge as the district confronts a federal investigation involving Superintendent Alberto Carvalho and looming budget and labor challenges.

item.title: South Torrance baseball defeats El Segundo with Owen Rhodes’ walk-off hit
item.description: South Torrance pulls out a victory in the bottom of the seventh after Chase Mattoon's three-run home run ties the game for El Segundo in the top of the seventh.

item.title: Dodgers shut out Royals in Cactus League night game
item.description: The Dodgers have a pair of three-run innings, Miguel Rojas has three hits out of the leadoff spot and eight pitchers combine to allow just three hits in a 6-0 win on Friday night at Camelback Ranch.

item.title: Reports: Raiders trading Maxx Crosby to Ravens for two 1st-round picks
item.description: Baltimore will acquire the five-time Pro Bowl defensive end from Las Vegas in exchange for first-round picks this year (No. 14 overall) and in 2027. The deal is contingent on Crosby passing a physical next week.

item.title: Aaron Judge, Brice Turang power Team USA to rout of Brazil in WBC opener
item.description: Judge hits a two-run homer in his first at-bat, Turang has three hits and four RBIs and the U.S. squad draws 17 walks in a 15-5 win in Houston. Lucas Ramirez the son of 12-time All-Star Manny Ramirez, homers twice for Brazil.

item.title: Chris Kreider, Alex Killorn help Ducks survive a wild game with Canadiens
item.description: Kreider gets the tying goal with 42 seconds left in regulation and Killorn scores in the sixth round of a shootout, as the Ducks blow a two-goal lead in the third period but win for the seventh time in eight games, 6-5.

item.title: Clippers squander 25-point lead in loss to Spurs
item.description: Kawhi Leonard has 30 points for the Clippers, but Victor Wembanyama scores 27 to help San Antonio rally for a 117-112 win in a wild finish that denies the Clippers in their latest bid to reach a .500 record.

item.title: Luka Doncic dominates Pacers in 44-point effort for LeBron-less Lakers
item.description: Doncic, whom Indiana coach Rick Carlisle called “impossible to game plan for” before the game, proves it with a dazzling effort then gets to sit out the fourth quarter in a 128-117 win.
